items.title: Death of dog after avian influenza exposure in Alberta marks second such case in Canada
items.description: A dog in Alberta died in November after being exposed to highly pathogenic avian influenza. It's the second confirmed fatal case of avian flu in a domestic dog in Canada, with the first being reported in Ontario in 2023.

items.title: Group loses latest court battle to halt tree removal at Vancouver's Stanley Park
items.description: A group trying to save thousands of trees from being cut down in Vancouver's famed Stanley Park has lost another legal battle.
